claims.text: Contracts: `cma run`'s evidence record keeps exactly today's top-level keys and today's policy keys (R53, additive only), and the pack's evidence carries those statement keys per account in the same shapes with the policy key unchanged.

P8: monthly.csv text cells (account, month, notes, line ids) never begin with = + - @ tab or CR, including with hostile line ids such as =HYPERLINK(1); value columns are numbers. Test is marked invariants and named p8.

Idempotency and partial failure (failure-modes checklist): the pack, now three files, is written once; a second sign-off is refused and never overwrites; a crash leftover is removed and no partial pack is visible; log entries follow the folder rename and a refused entry removes the pack. Existing sign-off tests were updated to expect monthly.csv and pass.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest -q tests/test_signoff.py -k "second or twice or once or leftover or stopped"

claims.text: Data/PII (data checklist): evidence holds ids, figures, hashes, overrides and the sign-off, no line description (asserted in test_pack_evidence_v1_names_every_input_the_sign_off_and_offline_egress); monthly.csv's hash is recorded in the signed_off case-log entry (R42). No migration: evidence v1 is additive; nothing to backfill.
Security checklist: no new entry point (sign_off and its callers already existed); no new dependency (csv, io, decimal are stdlib); lint clean.
claims.proof_cmd: ruff check src tests && python -m compileall -q src && echo compile-ok

claims.text: No regression across the full suite and the contracts tier.

notes: I changed nothing. The implementer's commit aee8283 already holds the change, and every claim above was produced against it. Checklist lines I am treating as not applicable: performance (no queries; the CSV is one row per month per account); timeouts and retries (the pack write makes no external call); feature flag (sign-off is a new command and pack files are immutable; rollback is a reinstall). Gaps for the owner: (1) Observability and alerting: no alert, which matches the local-first design (refusal plus exit code); there is still no log line that counts monthly.csv rows. (2) Average and lowest balance cells can be negative, e.g. -46.55. They are left as bare numbers starting with '-', not neutralised, because P8 covers text cells and spreadsheets read them as numbers. Confirm that this reading of R34/P8 is acceptable. (3) The hidden policy_check omits the label; the design lists the label alongside 'shown or hidden', so confirm the label is only wanted when the check is shown. (4) Evidence carries override reasons and names typed by the underwriter. The design lists both, and they stay inside the owner-only case folder.
